    The outward affine-D4 star is representation-infinite #

    The radical-square-zero algebra with one central vertex and four outward arrows has an explicit one-parameter family of pairwise nonisomorphic six-dimensional indecomposable modules. Consequently it cannot occur as an algebra quotient of a representation-finite algebra over an infinite field.
